title: Contingency Placement Agreements: Tier Entry Volumes, Review Interval, Downgrade Tolerance and Volume Rebate
content:
The tiers of the Contingency Placement Agreements are contingency rate schedules priced by the client's annual placement volume. Each tier has an entry volume and a minimum initial term, and carries its own review interval, downgrade tolerance and volume rebate terms.

## Tier ladder

| Rank | Tier | Entry: minimum annual placement volume (USD) | Entry: minimum initial term (months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Starter Contingency Agreement | 0.00 | 12 |
| 2 | Standard Contingency Agreement | 50000.00 | 12 |
| 3 | Preferred Contingency Agreement | 250000.00 | 12 |
| 4 | Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 1000000.00 | 24 |
| 5 | Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 5000000.00 | 24 |
| 6 | Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 20000000.00 | 36 |

## Review and rebate figures

- **Review interval** — the months between volume reviews of the agreement tier.
- **Downgrade tolerance** — the percent by which trailing volume may fall below the tier's entry volume before a downgrade at review.
- **Volume rebate threshold** — the trailing 12-month collections above which an annual fee rebate is credited, in USD; 0.00 means no rebate.
- **Volume rebate percent** — the annual rebate as a percentage of contingency fees billed in the review year; 0.0 means no rebate.

| Tier | Review interval (months) | Downgrade tolerance (percent) | Volume rebate threshold (USD) | Volume rebate (percent of fees billed in the review year) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 12 | 10.0 | 0.00 | 0.0 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 12 | 10.0 | 0.00 | 0.0 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 12 | 10.0 | 0.00 | 0.0 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 12 | 15.0 | 500000.00 | 1.0 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 12 | 15.0 | 2000000.00 | 2.0 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 12 | 20.0 | 5000000.00 | 3.0 |

**Hypothetical reading.** The Starter, Standard and Preferred Contingency Agreements carry no volume rebate, their threshold being 0.00 USD and their rebate 0.0 percent. On the Enterprise Contingency Agreement the rebate is 2.0 percent of the contingency fees billed in the review year, credited when trailing 12-month collections are above 2000000.00 USD.
